name: UAE Data Office (simulated)
mandate:
Simulated UAE Data Office, established by Federal Decree-Law 44/2021 and the "Bureau" of the Personal
Data Protection Law (FDL 45/2021, Art. 1). It implements control over the application of federal
data-protection legislation and conducts investigations, receives complaints and issues guidance
(FDL 44/2021, Art. 3). Under the PDPL, controllers notify it of personal-data breaches (Art. 9) and it
approves cross-border transfer cases (Art. 22). The PDPL does not apply to personal health data that
has its own legislation (Art. 2(2)(e)), so its role for health data must be established case by case.
limitations: Simulation of a role; not an official position of the real institution.
